movie_recording_button.name: t (movie recording) button
movie_recording_button.default_function: Start and stop movie recording while in still photography mode; its role can be assigned through FUNCTION (Fn) SETTING, and a separate playback role can be configured.

rear_command_dial.name: Rear command dial
rear_command_dial.default_function: Adjust exposure settings by shooting mode, highlight menu items, adjust quick-menu settings, and zoom during playback; its function can be configured for each shooting mode.

shutter_button.name: Shutter button
shutter_button.default_function: Press halfway to focus and lock focus and exposure; press fully to take a photograph. In F (movie) and Vlog modes, press to start or stop movie recording.

quick_menu_button.name: Q (quick menu) button
quick_menu_button.default_function: Display the quick menu by default; its role can be assigned through FUNCTION (Fn) SETTING.

film_simulation_dial.name: Film simulation dial
film_simulation_dial.default_function: Select the film simulation; C uses the film-simulation setting configured in the menus or quick menu.

front_command_dial.name: Front command dial
front_command_dial.default_function: Adjust exposure settings by shooting mode, select menu tabs or pages, select quick-menu items, and view pictures during playback. Press the center during shooting to choose an assigned function.

power_switch.name: ON/OFF switch
power_switch.default_function: Turn the camera on or off.

drive_delete_button.name: DRIVE button; b (delete) button
drive_delete_button.default_function: Display the drive-mode menu during shooting; delete pictures during playback.

ael_afl_button.name: AEL (exposure lock)/AFL (focus lock) button
ael_afl_button.default_function: Lock focus and exposure by default; its role can be assigned through FUNCTION (Fn) SETTING.

focus_stick.name: Focus stick (focus lever)
focus_stick.default_function: Tilt to select the focus area or navigate menus; press the center to select or adjust the focus area. Tilt and center-press functions can be configured.

menu_ok_button.name: MENU/OK button
menu_ok_button.default_function: Display menus and select or confirm the highlighted item.

disp_back_bluetooth_button.name: DISP (display)/BACK button; x (Bluetooth) button
disp_back_bluetooth_button.default_function: Control display information or go back; press for Bluetooth settings in shooting mode, or hold DISP/BACK during playback to open Bluetooth settings.

touchscreen.name: Touch screen
touchscreen.default_function: In shooting, touch to shoot, autofocus, select a focus or zoom point, or turn touch mode off; during playback, swipe to view other pictures. Touch-function flick gestures are disabled by default and can be assigned.

lens_release_button.name: Lens release button
lens_release_button.default_function: Press while rotating the lens to remove it.

battery_chamber_cover_latch.name: Battery-chamber cover latch
battery_chamber_cover_latch.default_function: Slide to open or close the battery-chamber cover.

battery_latch.name: Battery latch
battery_latch.default_function: Press to the side to release the battery for removal.
